eval: (async () => { const o = await fetch('/api/overview', {headers: {connection: 'close'}}).then((r) => r.json()); const ready = o.data.byStatus.find((item) => item.status === 'ready')?.count ?? 0; const label = [...document.querySelectorAll('main button')].map((b) => b.innerText.trim()).find((t) => t.startsWith('全部转录')); if (label !== '全部转录（' + ready + '）') throw Error('button count must equal the server stage count: ' + label + ' vs ' + ready); return { label, ready }; })()
